mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM PEACH_TENANT WHERE ID = #{tenantRefId} AND TENANT_CODE = 'PLATFORM' AND STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND IS_DELETE = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = M.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.TENANT_CODE = 'PLATFORM' AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_USER U ON U.ID = M.USER_REF_ID AND U.STATUS IN ('1', 'ENABLE') AND U.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = #{appRefId} AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B ON B.TENANT_REF_ID = M.TENANT_REF_ID AND B.MEMBER_REF_ID = M.ID AND B.APP_REF_ID = A.ID AND B.SCOPE_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND B.SCOPE_REF_ID IS NULL AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = T.ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = A.ID AND R.ROLE_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = T.ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL AND P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL AND P.DELEGABLE = 0 AND P.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'API' AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE M.ID = #{memberRefId} AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 AND M.VERSION = #{memberVersion} AND M.AUTH_VERSION = #{authVersion} AND P.PERMISSION_CODE = 'PLATFORM.TENANT.CREATE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_TENANT (ID, TENANT_ID, TENANT_CODE, TENANT_NAME, STATUS, SORT_NUM, IS_DELETE, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{tenantCode}, #{tenantName}, 'ENABLE', 0, 0, #{createdTime}, #{operatorRefId})

INSERT INTO PEACH_APPLICATION (ID, APP_ID, APP_NAME, APP_TYPE, IS_OPEN, APP_DESC, TENANT_ID, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID, IS_DELETE) VALUES (#{id}, #{appId}, #{appName}, 'SYSTEM', 1, 'Tenant administration', #{tenantId}, #{createdTime}, #{operatorRefId}, 0)

INSERT INTO PEACH_ORGANIZATION (ID, ORG_ID, TENANT_ID, PARENT_ORG_REF_ID, ORG_CODE, ORG_NAME, STATUS, SORT_NUM, VERSION, IS_DELETE, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{orgId}, #{tenantId}, NULL, 'DEFAULT', #{orgName}, 'ENABLE', 0, 0, 0, #{createdTime}, #{operatorRefId})

INSERT INTO PEACH_ROLE (ID, ROLE_ID, TENANT_ID, ORG_ID, ROLE_CODE, ROLE_NAME, ROLE_DESC, ROLE_SCOPE, ROLE_TYPE, TENANT_REF_ID, APP_REF_ID, ROLE_STATUS, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID, IS_DELETE) VALUES (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{tenantId}, 'TENANT', 'ROLE_TENANT_OWNER', '租户所有者', '系统保护的租户初始所有者', 'TENANT', 'SYSTEM', #{tenantRefId}, #{appRefId}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{createdTime}, #{creatorId}, 0)

INSERT INTO PEACH_ROLE_DATA_POLICY (ID, TENANT_REF_ID, APP_REF_ID, ROLE_REF_ID, PERMISSION_REF_ID, DATA_SCOPE, ORG_REF_ID, STATUS, IS_DELETE, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantRefId}, #{appRefId}, #{roleRefId}, #{permissionRefId}, 'TENANT_ALL', NULL, 'ACTIVE', 0, 0, #{createdTime}, #{operatorRefId})
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS permissionRefId, PERMISSION_CODE AS permissionCode, OWNER_TYPE AS ownerType FROM PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION WHERE OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL AND APP_REF_ID IS NULL AND DELEGABLE = 1 AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND IS_DELETE = 0 ORDER BY PERMISSION_CODE LIMIT 257
